entries.dialogueText: "No hunting this time. A university speech seems more your speed."

entries.dialogueText: "No. It isn't."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Good. I want everyone to know how..."
entries.dialogueText: "Good. I want everyone to know how I feel."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina

entries.dialogueText: "How can you possibly think I'd be happy?"

entries.speaker: Princess Vina

entries.dialogueText: "That would depend on the speech's contents."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Are you excited to see Cousin Rico..."
entries.dialogueText: "Are you excited to see Cousin Rico again?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""My old alma mater. If I have time,..."
entries.dialogueText: "My old alma mater. If I have time, I'll give you a tour."

entries.dialogueText: My daughter shrugged.

entries.dialogueText: The driver came around to open my door. I took a look out the window.

entries.dialogueText: We'd stopped right in front of the statue of my father.

entries.speaker: Narrator

entries.dialogueText: His head was still missing.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Our heads were still missing."
entries.dialogueText: Our heads were still missing.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "His head had been replaced. The lik..."
entries.dialogueText: His head had been replaced. The likeness looked good as new.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We'd stopped right in front of the..."
entries.dialogueText: We'd stopped right in front of the statues of myself and my father.

entries.speaker: Narrator

entries.dialogueText: We'd stopped right in front of the statues of myself and my family.

entries.dialogueText: Our heads had been replaced. The likenesses looked good as new.

entries.dialogueText: "I don't think you should exit the car yet, Your Majesty."

entries.dialogueText: Titus' voice came from the passenger seat.

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""My scouts reported a number of ind..."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""My scouts reported a number of ind..."
entries.dialogueText: "My scouts reported a number of individuals protesting near the entrance. A mix of students and foreigners, by the looks of it."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""My scouts reported an altercation..."
entries.dialogueText: "My scouts reported an altercation close to the entrance. Su Omina members fighting a migrant activist group, by the looks of it."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Titus' voice came from the passenge..."
entries.dialogueText: Titus' voice came from the passenger seat.

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""My scouts have given the all-clear..."
entries.dialogueText: "My scouts have given the all-clear. It's fine to exit the car."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Shit. Why haven't the police dealt..."
entries.dialogueText: "Shit. Why haven't the police dealt with it?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Not a problem. Just a bit of healt..."
entries.dialogueText: "Not a problem. Just a bit of healthy dissent."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Su Omina is on the side of the Cro..."
entries.dialogueText: "Su Omina is on the side of the Crown. Always has been."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Not anymore.""
entries.dialogueText: "Not anymore."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Because the police are on their si..."
entries.dialogueText: "Because the police are on their side."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She smiled bleakly."
entries.dialogueText: She smiled bleakly.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I should have expected this.""
entries.dialogueText: "I should have expected this."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""It's what Manus would have wanted.""
entries.dialogueText: "It's what Manus would have wanted."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Yet another warm welcome.""
entries.dialogueText: "Yet another warm welcome."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Should the offenders be removed?""
entries.dialogueText: "Should the offenders be removed?"

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Good question.""
entries.dialogueText: "Good question."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Not anymore, apparently.""
entries.dialogueText: "Not anymore, apparently."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""It doesn't bode well for your own..."
entries.dialogueText: "It doesn't bode well for your own health."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""The fact that local law enforcemen..."
entries.dialogueText: "The fact that local law enforcement hasn't stepped in is troubling."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Obviously. Use as much force as yo..."
entries.dialogueText: "Obviously. Use as much force as you need."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Yes. But don't forget about that o..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes. But don't forget about that other task you're here for."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Leave them be. Just make sure I do..."
entries.dialogueText: "Leave them be. Just make sure I don't get attacked."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""My men will get on it as soon as y..."
entries.dialogueText: "My men will get on it as soon as you're safely inside."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""No, it's fine. I need your full at..."
entries.dialogueText: "No, it's fine. I need your full attention on that other task you're here for."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Seems like we're getting a warmer..."
entries.dialogueText: "Seems like we're getting a warmer welcome than last time."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Perfect. Be ready to fend off the..."
entries.dialogueText: "Perfect. Be ready to fend off the affections of my adoring subjects."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Are you sure? I don't want any unp..."
entries.dialogueText: "Are you sure? I don't want any unpleasant surprises."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Excellent. The less you have to fo..."
entries.dialogueText: "Excellent. The less you have to focus on troublemakers, the more you can focus on that other assignment you're here for."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""We'll get right on it as soon as y..."
entries.dialogueText: "We'll get right on it as soon as you're safely inside the building."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Rest assured local law enforcement..."
entries.dialogueText: "Rest assured local law enforcement is doing its job."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""I'm pleased local law enforcement..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm pleased local law enforcement is doing its job."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Yes, I don't want any unpleasant s..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, I don't want any unpleasant surprises. But try not to use violence."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Will do.""
entries.dialogueText: "Will do."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Copy that.""
entries.dialogueText: "Copy that."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""We won't.""
entries.dialogueText: "We won't."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""My men will get on it as soon as y..."
entries.dialogueText: "My men will get on it as soon as you're safely inside."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Titus slipped out of the car. I hea..."
entries.dialogueText: Titus slipped out of the car. I heard screams and the whack of batons as the Golden Guard descended on the crowd.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Titus slipped out of the car. I hea..."
entries.dialogueText: Titus slipped out of the car. I heard shouts of defiance and the hiss of tear gas as the Golden Guard descended on the crowd.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Titus and his guards shielded Vina..."
entries.dialogueText: Titus and his guards shielded Vina and me as we walked through the roiling crowd.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "All around me were men and women in..."
entries.dialogueText: All around me were men and women in the blue-gold attire of Su Omina. I heard shouts of "Rizia for Rizians!" and "Cleanse the stain!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I heard shouts of "Rights for all!"..."
entries.dialogueText: I heard shouts of "Rights for all!" and "Down with House Toras!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "To my relief, we made it into the a..."
entries.dialogueText: To my relief, we made it into the auditorium unscathed.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Titus and his guards shielded me as..."
entries.dialogueText: Titus and his guards shielded me as we walked through the roiling crowd.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Vina kept her gaze forward. If she..."
entries.dialogueText: Vina kept her gaze forward. If she was feeling anything, she didn't show it.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A few minutes later, he returned to..."
entries.dialogueText: A few minutes later, he returned to escort me into the auditorium.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A few minutes later, Titus returned..."
entries.dialogueText: A few minutes later, Titus returned to escort us into the auditorium.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I was halfway to the stage when the..."
entries.dialogueText: I was halfway to the stage when the hall erupted into cheers. I turned my head to see Vina and Manus waving to the crowd.

entries.dialogueText: I took my place on stage next to Rico. He was seated with his legs spread out, his expression radiating barely concealed disdain.

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion

entries.dialogueText: "Of course, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Narrator

entries.dialogueText: Plainclothes police officers guarded the building doors. They saluted me as I went inside.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I got quite the reception on my wa..."
entries.dialogueText: "I got quite the reception on my way in. You had better have an explanation."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Let's get this over with, eh?""
entries.dialogueText: "Let's get this over with, eh?"

entries.dialogueText: Vina split off for the front row as I took my place on stage next to Rico. He was seated with his legs spread out, his expression radiating barely concealed disdain.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I heard shouts of "Rights for all!"..."
entries.dialogueText: I heard shouts of "Rights for all!" and "Stop the war!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It could be worse. At least Manus..."
entries.dialogueText: "It could be worse. At least Manus Sazon isn't here."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Sit properly and show some respect..."
entries.dialogueText: "Sit properly and show some respect to this venerable institution, Duke Ricardus."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My cousin gave me a sly grin."
entries.dialogueText: My cousin gave me a sly grin.

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""Good bloody riddance. And I do mea..."
entries.dialogueText: "Good bloody riddance. And I do mean bloody."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""Sorry, cousin. But the police you..."
entries.dialogueText: "Sorry, cousin. But the police you sent me are completely useless."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""Useless against the real problems..."
entries.dialogueText: "Useless against the real problems plaguing Iza, that is. When it comes to Su Omina, all of a sudden they realize they've got a job to do."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""Sorry, cousin. I tried to tell Su..."
entries.dialogueText: "Sorry, cousin. I tried to tell Su Omina to rein it in, but, well. You know how they get."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""They're just feeling a little thre..."
entries.dialogueText: "They're just feeling a little threatened, is all. But don't provoke them, and they won't provoke you."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "Shit. Why haven't the police dealt with it?"

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Because they're outnumbered.""
entries.dialogueText: "Because they're outnumbered."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Shouts of "Rizia for Rizians!" and..."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""Sorry, cousin. I did what I could.""
entries.dialogueText: "Sorry, cousin. I did what I could."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""But the police here are stretched..."
entries.dialogueText: "But the police here are stretched to their limit."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Looking pretty peaceful around her..."
entries.dialogueText: "Looking pretty peaceful around here these days."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He grinned proudly."
entries.dialogueText: He grinned proudly.

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""It is, isn't it?""
entries.dialogueText: "It is, isn't it?"

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""Don't let looks deceive you, Your..."
entries.dialogueText: "Don't let looks deceive you, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""The whole population of this city..."
entries.dialogueText: "The whole population of this city is out to get me. Including those so-called police you sent."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""The whole population of this city..."
entries.dialogueText: "The whole population of this city is out to get me. And the police can't do a damn thing about it."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""I can't thank you enough for those..."
entries.dialogueText: "I can't thank you enough for those reinforcements you sent. Really helped me get Iza into shape."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""I had my doubts about those Centra..."
entries.dialogueText: "I had my doubts about those Central Police reinforcements you sent. But they've really helped me get Iza into shape."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""They don't respect me around here...."
entries.dialogueText: "They don't respect me around here. I don't see why I should respect them."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""You said it.""
entries.dialogueText: "You said it."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""This 'venerable institution' shoul..."
entries.dialogueText: "This 'venerable institution' should be worried about earning my respect."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He reluctantly assumed a more forma..."
entries.dialogueText: He reluctantly assumed a more formal pose.

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""But as His Majesty commands.""
entries.dialogueText: "But as His Majesty commands."

entries.dialogueText: There was polite applause from the audience as Rico took the stage.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My cousin stepped behind the podium..."
entries.dialogueText: My cousin stepped behind the podium and cleared his throat.

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""As reigning Duke of Iza, I am hono..."
entries.dialogueText: "As reigning Duke of Iza, I am honored to speak at the anniversary of Rizia's most renowned university."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Nobody clapped as Rico took the sta..."
entries.dialogueText: Nobody clapped as Rico took the stage.

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""I must confess to you all, the onl..."
entries.dialogueText: "I must confess to you all, the only higher education I've received is from the School of Life. And I haven't even graduated yet."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""But when I took charge of Iza, I r..."
entries.dialogueText: "But when I took charge of Iza, I realized what an important role this institution plays."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""But I expect you knew that already..."
entries.dialogueText: "But I expect you knew that already, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "His voice assumed an icy tone."
entries.dialogueText: His voice assumed an icy tone.

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""At least the students won't give u..."
entries.dialogueText: "At least the students won't give us much trouble. Not with most of of the boys fighting in Pales."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""Iza University was founded in orde..."
entries.dialogueText: "Iza University was founded in order to preserve our kingdom's cherished traditions and pass them on to the next generation."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""Though there were years when Iza U..."
entries.dialogueText: "Though there were years when Iza University lost its way, I am happy to say that it still serves that purpose today."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""To instill young people like yours..."
entries.dialogueText: "To instill young people like yourselves with a stable moral center, even when one is lacking outside these walls."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""But somehow, over the years, that..."
entries.dialogueText: "But somehow, over the years, that purpose was lost."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""Like the rest of Rizia, this schoo..."
entries.dialogueText: "Like the rest of Rizia, this school has become a breeding ground for an ideology that prioritizes foreign perspectives over our own."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""This school has become a breeding..."
entries.dialogueText: "This school has become a breeding ground for an ideology that prioritizes foreign perspectives over our own."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""A place where this nation's greate..."
entries.dialogueText: "A place where this nation's greatest achievements are seen as problems to be worried over, not triumphs to be celebrated."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""And where youths respond to the ha..."
entries.dialogueText: "And where youths respond to the harsh reality of war not by rising to defend their nation, but by waving signs and chanting."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""And where youths are led to believ..."
entries.dialogueText: "And where youths are led to believe that the complex realities of today can be solved by waving signs and chanting."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He glanced at me."
entries.dialogueText: He glanced at me.

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""This isn't education. It's indoctr..."
entries.dialogueText: "This isn't education. It's indoctrination."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He leveled his gaze out at the audi..."
entries.dialogueText: He leveled his gaze out at the audience.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A few students began booing. Rico i..."
entries.dialogueText: A few students began booing. Rico ignored them.

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""This is exactly what I mean! You c..."
entries.dialogueText: "This is exactly what I mean! You can't speak the truth in this country without getting smeared with meaningless accusations."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "His mouth curled into a sneer."
entries.dialogueText: His mouth curled into a sneer.

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""See, this is exactly what I mean.""
entries.dialogueText: "See, this is exactly what I mean."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I realized the hall had gone deathl..."
entries.dialogueText: I realized the hall had gone deathly silent.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "Neither I nor anyone else spoke up..."
entries.dialogueText: Neither I nor anyone else spoke up as the student was unceremoniously dragged out of the auditorium.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Ha! Try and study your way out of..."
entries.dialogueText: "Ha! Try and study your way out of that!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Unhand her! By order of the king!""
entries.dialogueText: "Unhand her! By order of the king!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Nobody else spoke up as the student..."
entries.dialogueText: Nobody else spoke up as the student was unceremoniously dragged out of the auditorium.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The Su Omina members immediately le..."
entries.dialogueText: The Su Omina members immediately let go of the student. She raced past them and out of the auditorium.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The Su Omina members gave Rico a qu..."
entries.dialogueText: The Su Omina members gave Rico a questioning look. After a few long moments, he nodded.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "They let go of the student. She rac..."
entries.dialogueText: They let go of the student. She raced past them and out of the auditorium.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Rico watched with a small smile on..."
entries.dialogueText: Rico watched with a small smile on his face. Once the door had closed, he continued.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "All at once, the people sitting in..."
entries.dialogueText: All at once, the people sitting in the back row stood up. They were all wearing military-style jackets with patches bearing the Su Omina insignia.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The crowd erupted into fury."
entries.dialogueText: The crowd erupted into fury.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A student sitting near the front ye..."
entries.dialogueText: A student sitting near the front yelled "Totalist!". Rico jerked his head in her direction.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A few people in the back row laughe..."
entries.dialogueText: A few people in the back row laughed.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Nobody laughed. Rico frowned and co..."
entries.dialogueText: Nobody laughed. Rico frowned and continued.

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""Now, if I actually were a totalist..."
entries.dialogueText: "Now, if I actually were a totalist, do you think I'd let this young lady make it out of this auditorium alive?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Rico, get off the stage. It's time..."
entries.dialogueText: "Rico, get off the stage. It's time for the King to speak."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Get your men in there, Titus!""
entries.dialogueText: "Get your men in there, Titus!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""STOP THIS NONSENSE AT ONCE!""
entries.dialogueText: "STOP THIS NONSENSE AT ONCE!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The shouts subsided. All eyes in th..."
entries.dialogueText: The shouts subsided. All eyes in the hall were on me.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Rico opened his mouth to retort, th..."
entries.dialogueText: Rico opened his mouth to retort, then closed it. He nodded his assent.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Their boos escalated into full-thro..."
entries.dialogueText: Their boos escalated into full-throated shouts of "Down with the Duke!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Titus nodded towards the aisles. A..."
entries.dialogueText: Titus nodded towards the aisles. A number of officers in Central Police uniforms had the auditorium surrounded.

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""No need, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "No need, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""I can't, Your Majesty. They're on..."
entries.dialogueText: "I can't, Your Majesty. They're on their way back from that mission we talked about."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Right away, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "Right away, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He spoke a few words on his radio...."
entries.dialogueText: He spoke a few words on his radio. Within seconds, a number of Golden Guard members were in the aisles, trying to control the fracas.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You have made yourselves heard. It..."
entries.dialogueText: "You have made yourselves heard. It is time for the King to speak."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Then do it yourself.""
entries.dialogueText: "Then do it yourself."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We'll have to ride it out, then.""
entries.dialogueText: "We'll have to ride it out, then."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "With a quick salute, Titus jumped o..."
entries.dialogueText: With a quick salute, Titus jumped off the stage and raced into the aisle. After a few minutes, he had brought the fracas mostly under control.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The audience began cheering as he r..."
entries.dialogueText: The audience began cheering as he retreated from the podium. He spoke to me under his breath.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The students kept chanting for anot..."
entries.dialogueText: The students kept chanting for another minute or so. Eventually, their shouts subsided.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "After a few minutes, the crowd was..."
entries.dialogueText: After a few minutes, the crowd was silent again.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You will allow your Duke to finish..."
entries.dialogueText: "You will allow your Duke to finish his speech."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "After a minute or so, the shouts su..."
entries.dialogueText: After a minute or so, the shouts subsided.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I said nothing and waited for Rico..."
entries.dialogueText: I said nothing and waited for Rico to act.

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""That little interruption just prov..."
entries.dialogueText: "That little interruption just proved my point."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""That's enough, Rico. It's time for..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's enough, Rico. It's time for the King to speak."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""There will be no other interruptio..."
entries.dialogueText: "There will be no other interruptions. Let the Duke of Iza finish his speech."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""Thank you, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Rico tapped on the microphone."
entries.dialogueText: Rico tapped on the microphone.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He smiled."
entries.dialogueText: He smiled.

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""Within the same walls that once nu..."
entries.dialogueText: "Within the same walls that once nurtured the seeds of rebellion, we now foster a respect for our king and a pride in our shared heritage."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""If we are to win the war against P..."
entries.dialogueText: "If we are to win the war against Pales, we cannot allow the minds of our youths to become clouded by dissent and division."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""If we are to persevere as a kingdo..."
entries.dialogueText: "If we are to persevere as a kingdom, we cannot allow the minds of our youths to become clouded by dissent and division."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""And we must be ready to defend our..."
entries.dialogueText: "And we must be ready to defend our identity as Rizians at all costs, be it on the battlefield or in the lecture hall."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My cousin tapped on the microphone."
entries.dialogueText: My cousin tapped on the microphone.

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""Thank you, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I took Rico's place behind the podi..."
entries.dialogueText: I took Rico's place behind the podium. I could feel the tension in the hall.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The students in the crowd burst int..."
entries.dialogueText: The students in the crowd burst into applause as I took Rico's place behind the podium. Still, I could feel the lingering tension in the hall.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "His eyes filled with fury. He reluc..."
entries.dialogueText: His eyes filled with fury. He reluctantly nodded his assent.

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""I had this under control, Your Maj..."
entries.dialogueText: "I had this under control, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""Which is why I urge you to use thi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Which is why I urge you to use this occasion to come together as Rizians. To rejoice in the proud history of our kingdom, and look forward to its shining future."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He spoke under his breath as he ret..."
entries.dialogueText: He spoke under his breath as he retreated back to his seat.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I know. That's what worried me.""
entries.dialogueText: "I know. That's what worried me."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""That interruption should never hav..."
entries.dialogueText: "That interruption should never have happened in the first place."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""That girl had done nothing. You em..."
entries.dialogueText: "That girl had done nothing. You embarrassed us both."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""Where 'intellectual freedom' is en..."
entries.dialogueText: "Where 'intellectual freedom' is encouraged but patriotism is silenced."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""Where we are forced to discard our..."
entries.dialogueText: "Where we are forced to discard our centuries-old spiritual practices in the name of 'inclusivity'."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The audience had started speaking i..."
entries.dialogueText: The audience had started speaking in hushed whispers. They quieted down as I took Rico's place behind the podium.

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""You see what I'm up against. I dou..."
entries.dialogueText: "You see what I'm up against. I doubt you'll fare much better."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I have to try, don't I?""
entries.dialogueText: "I have to try, don't I?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Just watch. I'll have them eating..."
entries.dialogueText: "Just watch. I'll have them eating out of my hand."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You brought this on yourself, cous..."
entries.dialogueText: "You brought this on yourself, cousin. You embarrassed us both."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""We must not be ashamed to let our..."
entries.dialogueText: "We must not be ashamed to let our religion guide us, as it has our ancestors before us."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""We must proudly fly the banner of..."
entries.dialogueText: "We must proudly fly the banner of Wruhecism, even in the face of those who seek to diminish its importance."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""We must resist the siren call of '..."
entries.dialogueText: "We must resist the siren call of 'progressivism' and renew our faith in those who lead us by hereditary right."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""We must place our trust in our lea..."
entries.dialogueText: "We must place our trust in our leaders, whether elected by the people or appointed by hereditary right."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""And we must be ready to defend our..."
entries.dialogueText: "And we must be ready to defend our identity as Rizians at all costs, be it in the streets or in the lecture hall."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Moving in unison, they marched down..."
entries.dialogueText: Moving in unison, they marched down the aisle towards the student who'd shouted and roughly yanked her out of her seat.

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""If we cannot come together as Rizi..."
entries.dialogueText: "If we cannot come together as Rizians even on this historic occasion, then I fear for our future as a kingdom."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""Glovurius axa Rizia, and God save..."
entries.dialogueText: "Glovurius axa Rizia, and God save King Romus."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""I may not be a man of letters, but..."
entries.dialogueText: "I may not be a man of letters, but I do know you can't spell 'university' without 'unity'."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""Glovurius axa Rizia, God save King..."
entries.dialogueText: "Glovurius axa Rizia, God save King Romus, and God bless our troops. Thank you."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""Glovurius axa Rizia, God save Hous..."
entries.dialogueText: "Glovurius axa Rizia, God save House Toras, and God bless our troops. Thank you."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""Glovurius axa Rizia, and God save..."
entries.dialogueText: "Glovurius axa Rizia, and God save House Toras."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The audience burst into hurried app..."
entries.dialogueText: The audience burst into hurried applause. Rico held his head high as he returned to his seat.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The audience began jeering again. R..."
entries.dialogueText: The audience began jeering again. Rico stormed off and returned to his seat.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A mix of applause and jeers came fr..."
entries.dialogueText: A mix of applause and jeers came from the audience. Rico held his head high as he returned to his seat.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The dean walked back on stage and i..."
entries.dialogueText: The dean walked back on stage and introduced me.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I took Rico's place behind the podi..."
entries.dialogueText: I took Rico's place behind the podium. I could feel the tension in the hall.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The students in the crowd applauded..."
entries.dialogueText: The students in the crowd applauded as I stepped behind the podium. Still, I could feel the lingering tension in the hall.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I glanced at Titus. He had his ear..."
entries.dialogueText: I glanced at Titus. He had his ear to his radio again.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I glanced at Titus. He was scanning..."
entries.dialogueText: I glanced at Titus. He was scanning the crowd, alert for the slightest sign of danger.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He made eye contact with me and mou..."
entries.dialogueText: He made eye contact with me and mouthed the words, "It's done."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I took out the notes I'd prepared."
entries.dialogueText: I took out the notes I'd prepared.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Ladies and gentlemen of Iza.""
entries.dialogueText: "Ladies and gentlemen of Iza."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""My fellow cacti.""
entries.dialogueText: "My fellow cacti."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Dear brothers and sisters.""
entries.dialogueText: "Dear brothers and sisters."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""My loyal subjects.""
entries.dialogueText: "My loyal subjects."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""My fellow Rizians.""
entries.dialogueText: "My fellow Rizians."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "They rose and bowed politely as I p..."
entries.dialogueText: They rose and bowed politely as I proceeded down the hall.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A few students whooped."
entries.dialogueText: A few students whooped.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I am proud to be an alumnus of the..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am proud to be an alumnus of the oldest and most prestigious university in Rizia."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Looking out at all you bright youn..."
entries.dialogueText: "Looking out at all you bright young faces makes me wish I had gone to university myself."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""This is truly our kingdom's greate..."
entries.dialogueText: "This is truly our kingdom's greatest institute of higher learning -- besides my own Romus Toras University, of course."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""War, revolution, social upheaval -..."
entries.dialogueText: "War, revolution, social upheaval -- these halls have seen it all and lived to tell the tale."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I apologize for the earlier interr..."
entries.dialogueText: "I apologize for the earlier interruption. It was unbefitting of this momentous occasion."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""750 years. What a milestone -- not..."
entries.dialogueText: "750 years. What a milestone -- not only for this university, but for Rizia."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""After nearly a millennium, Iza Uni..."
entries.dialogueText: "After nearly a millennium, Iza University remains a beacon of freedom in a kingdom that has so rarely enjoyed it."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Like my cousin, I believe in the p..."
entries.dialogueText: "Like my cousin, I believe in the power of institutions like this one to shape the next generation of Rizians."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""This is truly our kingdom's greate..."
entries.dialogueText: "This is truly our kingdom's greatest institute of higher learning -- or at least, it will be until my own Romus Toras University is completed."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""And so it gives me no great pleasu..."
entries.dialogueText: "And so it gives me no great pleasure to see how far this school and the city around it have fallen."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Which is why I am truly dismayed t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Which is why I am truly dismayed that the Duke of Iza has allowed a culture of hate and intolerance to pervade this place."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The fact that the university has p..."
entries.dialogueText: "The fact that the university has persevered for so long is testament to the strength of this kingdom, its rulers and its people."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""And I am overjoyed to see how this..."
entries.dialogueText: "And I am overjoyed to see how this school and the city around it have flourished under House Toras' leadership."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I know that Iza still bears the ps..."
entries.dialogueText: "I know that Iza still bears the psychic scars of Lucas Sazon's unforgivable betrayal, just as my body bears the physical ones."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""And I sincerely regret that, for n..."
entries.dialogueText: "And I sincerely regret that, for nearly 30 years, the bright minds residing here have had to suffer under the thumb of House Toras."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I look at you all and I see the fu..."
entries.dialogueText: "I look at you all and I see the future that I want this country to have. Diverse, curious, unafraid to question authority."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""In another era, you would all be b..."
entries.dialogueText: "In another era, you would all be beheaded for such flagrant disobedience of your reigning Duke."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You are governed by a scion of Riz..."
entries.dialogueText: "You are governed by a scion of Rizia's noblest house. A cousin of the King himself. Yet you do not respect him."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I know that Iza still bears the ps..."
entries.dialogueText: "I know that Iza still bears the psychic scars of Lucas Sazon's unforgivable betrayal."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It is one thing to speak against y..."
entries.dialogueText: "It is one thing to speak against your Duke. It is another to speak against House Toras."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Rico was staring daggers at me. The..."
entries.dialogueText: Rico was staring daggers at me. The Su Omina members in the audience shifted in their seats uneasily.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I understand the allure of an orga..."
entries.dialogueText: "I understand the allure of an organization like Su Omina. But it is not the answer."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Iza is and will always be a proudl..."
entries.dialogueText: "Iza is and will always be a proudly multicultural city. Those who cannot accept that should leave."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""He speaks of unity, yet seeks to d..."
entries.dialogueText: "He speaks of unity, yet seeks to draw arbitrary lines between 'us' and 'them'."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Vina's eyes were burning holes in m..."
entries.dialogueText: Vina's eyes were burning holes in my head.

entries.dialogueText: "My family took it upon ourselves to keep the peace here after Duke and Duchess Sazon were deposed. I'm afraid we have failed."

entries.dialogueText: "I hereby call for the arrest of Duke Ricardus Toras for his role in the Friendship Day incident of 1950."

entries.dialogueText: "But I cannot only blame you. My cousin has failed miserably in his duties as a ruler."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "My body literally bears the scars of the Sazon family's betrayal. Yet what my cousin has done to you is just as bad as what they did to me."

entries.dialogueText: "Iza still bears the psychic scars of the Sazon family's betrayal. Yet my cousin's rein has been punishment enough."

entries.dialogueText: "I hereby announce that I am ordering his removal as Duke, as well as his immediate arrest."

entries.dialogueText: Titus approached him in order to cuff his hands.

entries.dialogueText: The audience roared. Rico's jaw dropped open in disbelief.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "Captain Gordion, arrest this man."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""You can't! I'm innocent!""
entries.dialogueText: "You can't! I'm innocent!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "He will be extradited to Wehlen for his role in the bloodshed."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Look at the progress we've made ov..."
entries.dialogueText: "Look at the progress we've made over the past few years. Do we want that to be undermined?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""For too long, nobles like my cousi..."
entries.dialogueText: "For too long, nobles like my cousin have lived off the labor of foreigners and commoners while treating them as an inconvenience at best."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The audience broke into animated ch..."
entries.dialogueText: The audience broke into animated chatter. Rico was staring daggers at me.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""My grandmother Lyza was right. Our..."
entries.dialogueText: "My grandmother Lyza was right. Our identity as Rizians is defined not by our nationality, but by our loyalty to the Crown."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The volume of the crowd was beginni..."
entries.dialogueText: The volume of the crowd was beginning to rise.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I looked over at Titus. It was time..."
entries.dialogueText: I looked over at Titus. It was time.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""To that, there can be only one res..."
entries.dialogueText: "To that, there can be only one response. Off with his head."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Rico looked agitated. His eyes dart..."
entries.dialogueText: Rico looked agitated. His eyes darted back and forth from me to the Su Omina members in the back row.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Rico looked agitated. His eyes dart..."
entries.dialogueText: Rico looked agitated. His eyes darted back and forth from me to the audience.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "I did not want to do this here. But I must tell you that my cousin was behind the horrific attack in Zille five years ago."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""And as we have recently discovered..."
entries.dialogueText: "And as we have recently discovered, betrayal runs in the family."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Such disharmony is a microcosm of..."
entries.dialogueText: "Such disharmony is a microcosm of Rizia as a whole. Where is the trust this kingdom once had in its leaders?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""In times of war, displaying insubo..."
entries.dialogueText: "In times of war, displaying insubordination towards your ruling house is tantamount to treason."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You will doom this kingdom with yo..."
entries.dialogueText: "You will doom this kingdom with your insubordination."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A shout of "Justice for Manus!" cam..."
entries.dialogueText: A shout of "Justice for Manus!" came from somewhere in the crowd.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I know that Iza still bears the ps..."
entries.dialogueText: "I know that Iza still bears the psychic scars of Lucas Sazon's unforgivable betrayal, just as my body bears the physical ones."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I know that Iza still bears the ps..."
entries.dialogueText: "I know that Iza still bears the psychic scars of Lucas Sazon's unforgivable betrayal."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I must especially commend my cousi..."
entries.dialogueText: "I must especially commend my cousin Ricardus for showing exceptional leadership in the face of turmoil."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I must especially commend the citi..."
entries.dialogueText: "I must especially commend the citizen patriots of Su Omina for their invaluable assistance here."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Having said that, I must admit my..."
entries.dialogueText: "Having said that, I must admit my family made a mistake in installing Ricardus Toras as your Duke."

entries.dialogueText: A wave of murmurs ran through the crowd. Rico was staring daggers at me.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""And as we have recently discovered..."
entries.dialogueText: "And as we have recently discovered, betrayal runs in the family."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The Su Omina members in the audienc..."
entries.dialogueText: The Su Omina members in the audience applauded loudly.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""And I am thankful that the poisono..."
entries.dialogueText: "And I am thankful that the poisonous influence of House Sazon has been leached out of this city, as venom from a snakebite."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I am grateful to the members of Ho..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am grateful to the members of House Sazon for their contributions to this kingdom. But their time is over. A new era has dawned."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""This city must serve as an example..."
entries.dialogueText: "This city must serve as an example for the rest of Rizia. Those who speak against their rulers will receive their just desserts."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We still have some distance to go...."
entries.dialogueText: "We still have some distance to go. But together, we will cleanse Iza of the stain that has marred it for so long."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Over and over again, he has failed..."
entries.dialogueText: "Over and over again, he has failed to display the backbone needed to get this city in line."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""When law enforcement does not play..."
entries.dialogueText: "When law enforcement does not play by his rules, he calls on disgruntled civilians to restore order."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""He goes hunting with automatic wea..."
entries.dialogueText: "He goes hunting with automatic weapons. That should tell you everything you need to know about his approach to leadership."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The audience laughed nervously. Ric..."
entries.dialogueText: The audience laughed nervously. Rico's face turned red.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The Su Omina members in the audienc..."
entries.dialogueText: The Su Omina members in the audience began booing.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I will tell you the truth. Rico To..."
entries.dialogueText: "I will tell you the truth. Rico Toras is a criminal and a conspirator. Were it not for him, we would have Zille back by now."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You should be receiving an educati..."
entries.dialogueText: "You should be receiving an education here. Instead, you are being brainwashed by Arcasian agents."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You should be receiving an educati..."
entries.dialogueText: "You should be receiving an education here. Instead, you are being brainwashed by agents of Malenyevism."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I can only hope that now that Iza..."
entries.dialogueText: "I can only hope that now that Iza has been leached of the poison that is House Sazon, you will be able to redeem yourselves."

entries.title: Narrator: "Both Vina and Manus were staring at..."
entries.dialogueText: Both Vina and Manus were staring at me intensely.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Nobody dared to speak."
entries.dialogueText: Nobody dared to speak.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You have all been poisoned by year..."
entries.dialogueText: "You have all been poisoned by years of Sazon rule. But it is not too late for redemption."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "Manus Sazon has received exactly the justice he deserves."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I will give you one last chance. Y..."
entries.dialogueText: "I will give you one last chance. You will bend the knee to House Toras or face the direst of consequences."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Our kingdom is at a turning point...."
entries.dialogueText: "Our kingdom is at a turning point. We are finally on the verge of claiming our lost territories and becoming whole again."

entries.dialogueText: Shrieks came from the audience as a dozen Su Omina members rushed the stage.

entries.speaker: Narrator

entries.dialogueText: Titus and his fellow Golden Guards moved swiftly to intercept them.

entries.dialogueText: He looked pleadingly at the Su Omina members in the audience. They didn't move a muscle.

entries.dialogueText: As Titus handcuffed my cousin and led him offstage, the audience burst into thunderous applause.

entries.dialogueText: "As I was saying."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "You're welcome, Iza."

entries.dialogueText: "I regret that you all had to witness that."

entries.dialogueText: "I do not wish to shift the focus from today's celebrations. But I will say this."

entries.dialogueText: "My reign is all about breaking away from the constraints of the past. It is time for Iza to do exactly that."

entries.dialogueText: "The truth is, there is no one 'Rizian' identity. And that's exactly how it should be."

entries.dialogueText: "Your current Duke is a disgrace to everything the noble House Toras stands for."

entries.dialogueText: I heard a few incredulous murmurs.

entries.dialogueText: "When you graduate and go forth into the world, I want you to keep questioning authority. Including mine."

entries.dialogueText: "Your voices matter to me. You are the future of this country, after all."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "Radical thinking is in Iza's blood. It even resulted in the spilling of mine."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Radical thinking is in Iza's blood..."
entries.dialogueText: "Radical thinking is in Iza's blood. I could not put an end to it if I wanted to."

entries.dialogueText: "I am asking you to be patient. The change you want to see is coming to Rizia. But it will take time."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""But I beg you to consider the cons..."
entries.dialogueText: "But I beg you to consider the consequences of your actions. The revolution you are calling for would only bring destruction to you and your loved ones."

entries.dialogueText: "But we are a kingdom at war. Now is not the time to let our petty differences tear us apart."

entries.dialogueText: "But the challenges our nation is facing are greater than any of our individual concerns. Now is not the time to let petty differences tear us apart."

entries.dialogueText: Rumbles of discontent rippled through the crowd.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""But in the end, the governance of..."
entries.dialogueText: "But in the end, the governance of Iza is the noble right -- and the burden -- of House Toras."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "However, I have determined that at this time, my cousin Ricardus is still the best choice to govern this city."

entries.dialogueText: "I urge you to put aside your grievances with myself and my cousin and focus on the real enemy: the foreigners on our doorstep."

entries.dialogueText: "You're lucky that your king is listening to you at all! In an earlier era, I'd have you beheaded."

entries.dialogueText: Officers from Lucita's Central Police force swiftly blocked the exit.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The Brenas police officers didn't b..."
entries.dialogueText: The Brenas police officers didn't budge.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A few officers began ineffectually..."
entries.dialogueText: A few officers began ineffectually trying to shepherd the students back to their seats.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Rico and I watched as the auditoriu..."
entries.dialogueText: Rico and I watched as the auditorium gradually emptied out.

entries.speaker: Narrator

entries.dialogueText: Nobody acknowledged my remark.

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Right away, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "Right away, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He signaled to his guards to block..."

entries.dialogueText: Only a few people remained seated. Vina and Manus were among them.
