entries.dialogueText: Only a few people remained seated. Manus was among them.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Only a handful of people remained s..."
entries.dialogueText: Only a handful of people remained seated.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Holding eye contact with me, he ros..."
entries.dialogueText: Holding eye contact with me, he rose from his chair, turned around and left the room as well.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Our kingdom is at a turning point...."
entries.dialogueText: "Our kingdom is at a turning point. We face countless enemies, and the most dangerous of all are those within our own borders."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""These are perilous times. We are a..."
entries.dialogueText: "These are perilous times. We are at risk of being destroyed by the nefarious forces outside our door."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Our enemies tried to destroy us fr..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our enemies tried to destroy us from within in the '20s. Little did they know Rizia would end up stronger than ever."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""As your King, I am relying on your..."
entries.dialogueText: "As your King, I am relying on your support to defeat Pales once and for all."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I am relying on you all to uphold..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am relying on you all to uphold Rizia's reputation."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""With God on our side, we will over..."
entries.dialogueText: "With God on our side, we will overcome every challenge."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I implore you to hold fast to your..."
entries.dialogueText: "I implore you to hold fast to your Rizian identity. Remember the values upon which this nation was built."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Time and time again, the Toras fam..."
entries.dialogueText: "Time and time again, the Toras family has led Rizia out of crisis. With your help, we will do so again."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Rizian, Wehzek, Derdian, Valgish -..."
entries.dialogueText: "Rizian, Wehzek, Derdian, Valgish -- I call on all subjects of the Crown to unite as one."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""If you learn one thing here, it sh..."
entries.dialogueText: "If you learn one thing here, it should be to trust in the superiority of your King and your ruling house."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We shall go forth from these halls..."
entries.dialogueText: "We shall go forth from these halls and fight for our country! Crush anyone who stands in our way!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I promise you, we will prosper as..."
entries.dialogueText: "I promise you, we will prosper as never before!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We will form new alliances and tak..."
entries.dialogueText: "We will form new alliances and take our rightful place on the global stage!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We will show the whole world that..."
entries.dialogueText: "We will show the whole world that monarchies still matter!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We will restore the glory days of..."
entries.dialogueText: "We will restore the glory days of our golden kingdom!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Rico firmly applauded from his seat..."
entries.dialogueText: Rico firmly applauded from his seat.

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""Hear, hear!""
entries.dialogueText: "Hear, hear!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My cousin stood bolt upright with h..."
entries.dialogueText: My cousin stood bolt upright with his hand over his heart.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Glovurius axa Rizia!""
entries.dialogueText: "Glovurius axa Rizia!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You may clap now.""
entries.dialogueText: "You may clap now."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""God bless you all, and God bless R..."
entries.dialogueText: "God bless you all, and God bless Rizia!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Thus speaketh your king!""
entries.dialogueText: "Thus speaketh your king!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Thunderous cheers came from the Su..."
entries.dialogueText: Thunderous cheers came from the Su Omina section of the audience. Everyone else applauded politely.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Lead the way. I'm done with this s..."
entries.dialogueText: "Lead the way. I'm done with this shitshow."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""No, I want to see what happens. I..."
entries.dialogueText: "No, I want to see what happens. I am staying."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Get Vina out, too. She could be in..."
entries.dialogueText: "Get Vina out, too. She could be in danger."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""All right. If you insist.""
entries.dialogueText: "All right. If you insist."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""If you're sure...""
entries.dialogueText: "If you're sure..."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Come on.""
entries.dialogueText: "Come on."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He gestured to Vina. She shook her..."
entries.dialogueText: He gestured to Vina. She shook her head.

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Of course.""
entries.dialogueText: "Of course."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "One of his guardsmen rushed to the..."
entries.dialogueText: One of his guardsmen rushed to the VIP row and pulled Vina and Manus towards the stage.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "One of his guardsmen rushed to the..."
entries.dialogueText: One of his guardsmen rushed to the VIP row and pulled Vina towards the stage.

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Get your hands off me! I don't nee..."
entries.dialogueText: "Get your hands off me! I don't need your protection."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I could still hear the sound of sho..."
entries.dialogueText: I could still hear the sound of shouts and fistfights as Rico and I followed Titus and his guards through the back door.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A shot suddenly rang out, followed..."
entries.dialogueText: A shot suddenly rang out, followed by ear-splitting cries.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The crowd had spread out into a cir..."
entries.dialogueText: The crowd had spread out into a circle. In the middle, splayed across the auditorium stairs, was the body of a student.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Titus grabbed my wrist. I saw his m..."
entries.dialogueText: Titus grabbed my wrist. I saw his men do the same with Vina.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Titus grabbed my wrist."
entries.dialogueText: Titus grabbed my wrist.

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""We're leaving, Your Majesty. Now.""
entries.dialogueText: "We're leaving, Your Majesty. Now."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The crowd's screams echoed in my ea..."
entries.dialogueText: The crowd's screams echoed in my ears as we disappeared through the back door.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I would therefore like to announce..."
entries.dialogueText: "I would therefore like to announce that I am removing Ricardus Toras from power. Effective immediately."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The audience roared. Rico shot out..."
entries.dialogueText: The audience roared. Rico shot out of his seat.

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""What? But, Your Majesty...""
entries.dialogueText: "What? But, Your Majesty..."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Titus grabbed his shoulders and for..."
entries.dialogueText: Titus grabbed his shoulders and forced him back into his chair.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The audience's chatter had escalate..."
entries.dialogueText: The audience's chatter had escalated into a cacophony. I motioned for silence.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The audience's chatter had escalate..."
entries.dialogueText: The audience's chatter had escalated into a cacophony. I motioned for silence.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Many wore outfits adorned with the..."
entries.dialogueText: Many wore outfits adorned with the Iza University mascot, an anthropomorphic cactus named Spikey.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The protesters surged towards the b..."
entries.dialogueText: The protesters surged towards the blocked doors.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "By sheer numbers, they managed to o..."
entries.dialogueText: By sheer numbers, they managed to overpower the guards and squeeze out of the building.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Some of the younger students began..."
entries.dialogueText: Some of the younger students began fighting with the guards. Before long, a full-on brawl had broken out.

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""We have to get you out of here. Th..."
entries.dialogueText: "We have to get you out of here. There's a back exit."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The university dean was still on st..."
entries.dialogueText: The university dean was still on stage with us. She looked at me questioningly.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What? There's no point in continui..."
entries.dialogueText: "What? There's no point in continuing."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I had an ending prepared, but I do..."
entries.dialogueText: "I had an ending prepared, but I don't think you're going to like it."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""So, Iza has shown its true colors.""
entries.dialogueText: "So, Iza has shown its true colors."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Rico buried his head in his hands."
entries.dialogueText: Rico buried his head in his hands.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I hope you're happy with what you'..."
entries.dialogueText: "I hope you're happy with what you've done to this city, Rico."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""This is more than just student hij..."
entries.dialogueText: "This is more than just student hijinks. Our international enemies have had a hand in it."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""A little rebellion is normal at th..."
entries.dialogueText: "A little rebellion is normal at that age. Nothing to be worried about."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""What *I've* done? Your Majesty--""
entries.dialogueText: "What *I've* done? Your Majesty--"

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""No. Never mind.""
entries.dialogueText: "No. Never mind."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""If you'd just given me the resourc..."
entries.dialogueText: "If you'd just given me the resources to do my job--"

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""They just walked out on both their..."
entries.dialogueText: "They just walked out on both their king and duke. If that's normal, we're in trouble."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""But never mind. It's too late.""
entries.dialogueText: "But never mind. It's too late."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As we left the building, the splatt..."
entries.dialogueText: As we left the building, the splatters of red on the students' shirts remained seared into my consciousness.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "How much real blood would be spille..."
entries.dialogueText: How much real blood would be spilled before my reign ended?

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As we left the building, the capita..."
entries.dialogueText: As we left the building, the capital letters on the students' shirts remained seared into my consciousness.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Romus the Oppressor. Had my legacy..."
entries.dialogueText: Romus the Oppressor. Had my legacy already been spelled out for me?

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A hush came over the crowd as my an..."
entries.dialogueText: A hush came over the crowd as my announcement sank in.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Hesitantly, the students and teache..."
entries.dialogueText: Hesitantly, the students and teachers assembled began clapping.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Vina sat still. She wasn't applaudi..."
entries.dialogueText: Vina sat still. She wasn't applauding at all.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Vina and Manus both sat still. They..."
entries.dialogueText: Vina and Manus both sat still. They weren't applauding at all.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I looked at the House Sazon members..."
entries.dialogueText: I looked at the House Sazon members in the audience. They weren't applauding at all.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Manus sat still. He wasn't applaudi..."
entries.dialogueText: Manus sat still. He wasn't applauding at all.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The House Sazon nobles in the audie..."
entries.dialogueText: The House Sazon nobles in the audience applauded politely. I saw steel in their eyes.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "With fear in their eyes, the studen..."
entries.dialogueText: With fear in their eyes, the students and teachers assembled began clapping.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Rejoice, Iza! You are finally free!""
entries.dialogueText: "Rejoice, Iza! You are finally free!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Glovurius axa Rizia!""
entries.dialogueText: "Glovurius axa Rizia!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The auditorium reverberated with th..."
entries.dialogueText: The auditorium reverberated with thunderous applause.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""God bless this city!""
entries.dialogueText: "God bless this city!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Rico was still frozen to his seat...."
entries.dialogueText: Rico was still frozen to his seat. He seemed to be processing everything that had happened.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I looked over once more at the empt..."
entries.dialogueText: I looked over once more at the empty seat where Rico had been.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He was right. Hugo wouldn't stand f..."
entries.dialogueText: He was right. Hugo wouldn't stand for this.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "But with House Sazon on my side, pe..."
entries.dialogueText: But with House Sazon on my side, perhaps I could still weather the storm.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Power to the people!""
entries.dialogueText: "Power to the people!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Long live the King!""
entries.dialogueText: "Long live the King!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Peace has come to Iza at last!""
entries.dialogueText: "Peace has come to Iza at last!"

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Everyone dutifully applauded."
entries.dialogueText: Everyone dutifully applauded.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "But with the people on my side, per..."
entries.dialogueText: But with the people on my side, perhaps I could still weather the storm.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "But perhaps I could still weather t..."
entries.dialogueText: But perhaps I could still weather the storm.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I sat back down next to Rico."
entries.dialogueText: I sat back down next to Rico.

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""Well done, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "Well done, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I am quite the compelling public s..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am quite the compelling public speaker, aren't I?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""They hate us, Rico. They're just t..."
entries.dialogueText: "They hate us, Rico. They're just too afraid to express it."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""Then does it matter?""
entries.dialogueText: "Then does it matter?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I was just repairing the damage fr..."
entries.dialogueText: "I was just repairing the damage from your speech."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""A pity the audience wasn't more ap..."
entries.dialogueText: "A pity the audience wasn't more appreciative."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""One person got upset. Everyone els..."
entries.dialogueText: "One person got upset. Everyone else loved me."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'm just happy that I can go home..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm just happy that I can go home now."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""Same here.""
entries.dialogueText: "Same here."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The celebratory speeches wrapped up..."
entries.dialogueText: The celebratory speeches wrapped up, and Titus and his guards escorted us out of the auditorium's back entrance.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As we were exiting, I noticed a van..."
entries.dialogueText: As we were exiting, I noticed a van parked around the corner from the building. Muffled screams were emanating from it.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "It sounded like the voice of the st..."
entries.dialogueText: It sounded like the voice of the student who had been dragged away by Su Omina earlier.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "It sounded like the voice of the st..."
entries.dialogueText: It sounded like the voice of the student who had shouted at Rico earlier.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Titus led us away from the source o..."
entries.dialogueText: Titus led us away from the source of the sound towards the university gardens, where a lavish banquet awaited us.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Still, I ask you to have patience...."
entries.dialogueText: "Still, I ask you to have patience. Your duke is young, and has much to learn."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I have heard your calls for a chan..."
entries.dialogueText: "I have heard your calls for a change of leadership in this city. And I take them seriously."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I have faith that the good city of..."
entries.dialogueText: "I have faith that the good city of Iza will embrace peace and progress. Even with Duke Ricardus nominally holding the reins."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Yet it was the Lord who ordained t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yet it was the Lord who ordained that the Toras family would reign over Rizia. And I would not presume to interfere with His plans."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""My cousin is a tiger without teeth..."
entries.dialogueText: "My cousin is a tiger without teeth or claws. Leave him his title, and you can have the rest."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""And yes, that 'authority' includes..."
entries.dialogueText: "And yes, that 'authority' includes your own duke."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You are even willing to stand up t..."
entries.dialogueText: "You are even willing to stand up to your own king."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Even in a city where fanatical sup..."
entries.dialogueText: "Even in a city where fanatical supremacists are allowed to run rampant, you stand your ground."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You are coming of age in an era wh..."
entries.dialogueText: "You are coming of age in an era where ordinary Rizians are allowed more representation than ever before."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You are growing up at a time when..."
entries.dialogueText: "You are growing up at a time when what it means to be 'Rizian' is changing."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""But we can't forget our history an..."
entries.dialogueText: "But we can't forget our history and heritage, even as we hurtle into tomorrow."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It is places like Iza that represe..."
entries.dialogueText: "It is places like Iza that represent the values that our country is fighting for."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Yet there are people who stubbornl..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yet there are people who stubbornly cling to the unfair hierarchies and constrictive labels of the past."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Once we have reconquered Pales, I..."
entries.dialogueText: "Once we have reconquered Pales, I will turn my attention to the restructuring of Iza's government."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Change is at your fingertips. All..."
entries.dialogueText: "Change is at your fingertips. All you need to do is reach out and grasp it."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You, the people of Iza, have what..."
entries.dialogueText: "You, the people of Iza, have what it takes to rise up against your oppressors."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You have voted in a city council t..."
entries.dialogueText: "You have voted in a city council that prioritizes the rights of the previously disenfranchised. Use it."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Have faith in your ruling house. I..."
entries.dialogueText: "Have faith in your ruling house. It may take time, but order will prevail."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""My cousin is not the problem. It i..."
entries.dialogueText: "My cousin is not the problem. It is the flawed system that put him in power."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The audience tittered in astonishme..."
entries.dialogueText: The audience tittered in astonishment. Rico looked even more uncomfortable.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Someone in the audience yelled, "No..."
entries.dialogueText: Someone in the audience yelled, "Now!".

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Perhaps all of you can learn toget..."
entries.dialogueText: "Perhaps all of you can learn together what it means to coexist."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My remark was greeted by sullen sil..."
entries.dialogueText: My remark was greeted by sullen silence.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We must find a way to reconcile tr..."
entries.dialogueText: "We must find a way to reconcile tradition and modernity. Just as this fine university has done."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It was the Lord who ordained that..."
entries.dialogueText: "It was the Lord who ordained that the Toras family would reign over Rizia. And I would not presume to interfere with His plans."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Our venerable monarchy has carried..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our venerable monarchy has carried us this far. It will carry us further still."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We are anchored in gold. Connected..."
entries.dialogueText: "We are anchored in gold. Connected to our roots, but looking towards a shining future."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A few discontented rumblings came f..."
entries.dialogueText: A few discontented rumblings came from the audience.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "There was a smattering of polite ap..."
entries.dialogueText: There was a smattering of polite applause.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Remember, knowledge is your most p..."
entries.dialogueText: "Remember, knowledge is your most powerful weapon."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Do not underestimate the power of..."
entries.dialogueText: "Do not underestimate the power of organization. Together, you are greater than the sum of your parts."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Do not fall victim to calls for vi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Do not fall victim to calls for violence. The path of peace will get you further than you expect."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I have given you the tools to brea..."
entries.dialogueText: "I have given you the tools to break free of your chains. It is up to you to use them."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Glovurius axa Rizia!""
entries.dialogueText: "Glovurius axa Rizia!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""God bless you all!""
entries.dialogueText: "God bless you all!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Goooo Fighting Cacti!""
entries.dialogueText: "Goooo Fighting Cacti!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The King has spoken!""
entries.dialogueText: "The King has spoken!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Vina rose from her seat and began c..."
entries.dialogueText: Vina rose from her seat and began clapping. There was steel in her eyes.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Vina and Manus immediately rose fro..."
entries.dialogueText: Vina and Manus immediately rose from their seats and began clapping.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Manus rose from his seat and began..."
entries.dialogueText: Manus rose from his seat and began clapping. There was steel in his eyes.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The students and teachers assembled..."
entries.dialogueText: The students and teachers assembled rose and began clapping.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Before long, the entire auditorium..."
entries.dialogueText: Before long, the entire auditorium was reverberating with thunderous applause.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Rico sat still in his seat. His arm..."
entries.dialogueText: Rico sat still in his seat. His arms were folded.

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""Forgive me, Your Majesty, but... w..."
entries.dialogueText: "Forgive me, Your Majesty, but... what the hell was that?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You should be grateful. It was eit..."
entries.dialogueText: "You should be grateful. It was either that or have you deposed."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""A dose of the truth. Take it or le..."
entries.dialogueText: "A dose of the truth. Take it or leave it."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Just putting on a show for the kid..."
entries.dialogueText: "Just putting on a show for the kids. Don't worry, your job is safe."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""Some show.""
entries.dialogueText: "Some show."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""I'm as good as deposed now.""
entries.dialogueText: "I'm as good as deposed now."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""I'd prefer to leave it.""
entries.dialogueText: "I'd prefer to leave it."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""I assure you that my father won't..."
entries.dialogueText: "I assure you that my father won't stand for this."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The applause continued as we left o..."
entries.dialogueText: The applause continued as we left our seats and headed toward the banquet that had been prepared in our honor.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Rico was right. Hugo wouldn't stand..."
entries.dialogueText: Rico was right. Hugo wouldn't stand for this.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "But with Brenas on my side, there w..."
entries.dialogueText: But with Brenas on my side, there was still a chance I could weather the storm.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I implore you to hold fast to your..."
entries.dialogueText: "I implore you to hold fast to your identity. Remember the values upon which this nation was built. Only then can we find a way forward."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Time and time again, the Toras fam..."
entries.dialogueText: "Time and time again, the Toras family has led Rizia out of crisis. With your help, we will do so again."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Rizian, Wehzek, Derdian, Valgish -..."
entries.dialogueText: "Rizian, Wehzek, Derdian, Valgish -- I call on all subjects of the Crown to unite as one."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""In times of war, it is crucial we..."
entries.dialogueText: "In times of war, it is crucial we respect our established structures, even if we do not agree with them."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""In times of instability, it is cru..."
entries.dialogueText: "In times of instability, it is crucial we respect our established structures, even if we don't agree with them."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I ask you to engage in constructiv..."
entries.dialogueText: "I ask you to engage in constructive discourse. Do not abandon your convictions, but do not give in to the path of violence, either."

entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Glovurius axa Rizia!""
entries.dialogueText: "Glovurius axa Rizia!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "God bless you all!"

entries.dialogueText: "Goooo Fighting Cacti!"

entries.dialogueText: "The King has spoken!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Vina sat still. She wasn't applaudi..."
entries.dialogueText: Vina sat still. She wasn't applauding at all.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Vina and Manus both sat still. They..."
entries.dialogueText: Vina and Manus both sat still. They weren't applauding at all.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I looked at the House Sazon members..."
entries.dialogueText: I looked at the House Sazon members in the audience. They weren't applauding.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Manus sat still. He wasn't applaudi..."
entries.dialogueText: Manus sat still. He wasn't applauding at all.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Hesitantly, the students and teache..."
entries.dialogueText: Hesitantly, the students and teachers assembled began clapping.

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""That was... interesting, Your Maje..."
entries.dialogueText: "That was... interesting, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You can't please everybody.""
entries.dialogueText: "You can't please everybody."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'm just glad it's over. I can't w..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm just glad it's over. I can't wait to go home."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""At least nobody called me a totali..."
entries.dialogueText: "At least nobody called me a totalist."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""You know students. They would if t..."
entries.dialogueText: "You know students. They would if they thought they could get away with it."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It was either that or have you dep..."
entries.dialogueText: "It was either that or have you deposed. Be grateful."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""Sure.""
entries.dialogueText: "Sure."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""Same here.""
entries.dialogueText: "Same here."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""You could've tried harder to pleas..."
entries.dialogueText: "You could've tried harder to please your own family."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The celebratory speeches wrapped up..."
entries.dialogueText: The celebratory speeches wrapped up, and Titus and his guards escorted us out of the auditorium's back entrance.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As we were exiting, I noticed a van..."
entries.dialogueText: As we were exiting, I noticed a van parked around the corner from the building. Muffled screams were emanating from it.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "It sounded like the voice of the st..."
entries.dialogueText: It sounded like the voice of the student who had been dragged away by Su Omina earlier.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "It sounded like the voice of the st..."
entries.dialogueText: It sounded like the voice of the student who had shouted at Rico earlier.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Titus led us away from the source o..."
entries.dialogueText: Titus led us away from the source of the sound towards the university gardens, where a lavish banquet awaited us.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I wondered if I had managed to acco..."
entries.dialogueText: I wondered if I had managed to accomplish anything today.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A large crowd swarmed in front of t..."
entries.dialogueText: A large crowd swarmed in front of the university auditorium entrance.

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Just a bit of rabble-rousing. Noth..."
entries.dialogueText: "Just a bit of rabble-rousing. Nothing to worry about."

entries.dialogueText: "Sure."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""This is going to be *very* interes..."
entries.dialogueText: "This is going to be *very* interesting."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Is there something you're not tell..."
entries.dialogueText: "Is there something you're not telling me, Father?"

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""As your security councilor, I reco..."
entries.dialogueText: "As your security councilor, I recommend you allow my men to neutralize the offenders before proceeding into the auditorium."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Do what you have to. But don't let..."
entries.dialogueText: "Do what you have to. But don't let your new title get to your head."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Certainly not, sir.""
entries.dialogueText: "Certainly not, sir."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Some were holding a large banner th..."
entries.dialogueText: Some were holding a large banner that read "Welcome Home Angelica".

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I was halfway to the stage when the..."
entries.dialogueText: I was halfway to the stage when the hall erupted into cheers. I turned my head and  saw a dark-haired woman waving to the crowd. Angelica Sazon.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Behind him was a dark-haired woman...."
entries.dialogueText: Behind him was a dark-haired woman. Angelica.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Behind him was a dark-haired woman...."
entries.dialogueText: Behind him was a dark-haired woman. Angelica.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I stopped and waited for her to rea..."
entries.dialogueText: I stopped and waited for her to reach me.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I kept walking."
entries.dialogueText: I kept walking.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "All eyes turned towards the front r..."
entries.dialogueText: All eyes turned towards the front row, where Angelica was sitting. Her expression was one of pure disbelief.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Arise, Angelica!""
entries.dialogueText: "Arise, Angelica!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Rejoice, Iza! You are finally free!""
entries.dialogueText: "Rejoice, Iza! You are finally free!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I now invite Duchess Sazon to join..."
entries.dialogueText: "I now invite Duchess Sazon to join me onstage."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I watched her take it all in. Gradu..."
entries.dialogueText: I watched her take it all in. Gradually, her incredulity gave way to steely resolve.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I watched her take it all in. Gradu..."
entries.dialogueText: I watched her take it all in. Gradually, her incredulity gave way to pure joy.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I kept my eyes on her as the audito..."
entries.dialogueText: I kept my eyes on her as the auditorium reverberated with thunderous applause.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Gradually, her incredulity gave way..."
entries.dialogueText: Gradually, her incredulity gave way to steely resolve.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As she stood up, the auditorium rev..."
entries.dialogueText: As she stood up, the auditorium reverberated with thunderous applause.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Gradually, her incredulity gave way..."
entries.dialogueText: Gradually, her incredulity gave way to pure joy.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The auditorium reverberated with th..."
entries.dialogueText: The auditorium reverberated with thunderous applause as she slowly stood up and made her way towards the stage.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I kept my eyes on her as she took h..."
entries.dialogueText: I kept my eyes on her as she took her place next to me. Her incredulity had given way to steely resolve.

entries.title: Narrator: "I kept my eyes on her as she took h..."
entries.dialogueText: I kept my eyes on her as she took her place next to me. Her incredulity had given way to pure joy.
